affected_contracts: ADR front matter components list is the authoritative decision-to-component link; components.json decision_refs is derived from it and must never be hand-declared.
behavioral_effects: ADR front matter is now the single declaration of the ADR-to-component link; each component's decision_refs is derived at sync from the ADR components list and a hand-declaration is refused.

The five previously one-directional links now bind: agents->ADR-003, docling-mcp->ADR-004, rag->ADR-004, postgres-pgvector->ADR-005, backend-api->ADR-005. The annotation-only backend-api->ADR-001 link is dropped.
Only accepted and proposed decisions are derived onto components; superseded, deprecated, and rejected ones stop binding, because the successor carries the constraint.
ADR files live under docs/architecture/decisions/; the generated index stays at governance/history/decisions/index.json.

governance context names decisions as id, title, status, and path instead of a bare id, joins an ADR by its related_paths globs even when no component carries it, and trims decisions after conventions rather than before.
Summary.md groups decisions into Accepted, Proposed (awaiting review), and a count of retired ones.
New governance decision propose (make governance-decision-propose) scaffolds a proposed ADR with the next free id, only inside a change session; automation still never writes an accepted decision.
governance change finish prints, console-only, any decision binding the changed components that the record did not cite with --adr.

Fixed a pre-existing defect: annotation_files walked into nested git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/, so 8 of 19 components in the live components manifest were compiled from a stale checkout of another commit. Nested checkouts are now skipped by their .git marker.
Activated checks.references.check_document_references, which was registered but declared by no policy rule and therefore never ran.
compatibility_impact: decision-index schema gains the deprecated status and three optional fields (superseded_by, related_paths, policy_refs) - additive. local-governance schema loses the decision_refs property - breaking for any out-of-tree annotation that declares it; none exist in this repository and the new blocking rule names the repair. build_components and build_effective take an optional decision_index argument, defaulted, so all eight existing callers are unchanged.
follow_up: checks.references.check_check_impl_resolves is still registered with no policy rule declaring it. It is largely redundant with the inline guard in run_checks, so decide whether to declare it or delete it.
Promote adr-front-matter-is-well-formed, adr-references-are-consistent, and document-references-resolve per their promotion_criteria once evidence accumulates.

SKIP_FILES silences a whole document. A partially-historical file such as ADR-001 would be better served by a per-section or per-line frozen marker; revisit in Phase 3 when more docs enter the corpus.
The four nested worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ are stale checkouts of other commits and one is locked. They are now ignored by governance, but they still cost disk and confuse repo-wide greps.
limitations: Simplification pass: not run. The change is mechanical moves plus additive code, ruff check and format are clean, and a restructuring pass over new code with no second caller yet would be speculative.
governance/manifests/curated/architectural-intent.json held seven decision_refs declarations, not the eight the plan predicted; with the two annotations the real total was nine.

preflight-ports failed throughout this session because the development stack occupies ports 3000, 5001, 8090, 8100, and 8201-8203. Phase 1 starts no container, so the gate was recorded rather than satisfied; every other preflight signal was clean.

The hygiene Make target could not run as written on this Windows shell - it uses POSIX VAR=x cmd prefix syntax - so the underlying pre-commit command was run directly with SKIP set, per the CLAUDE.md instruction to run the underlying command rather than rewrite the target.
reason: The ADR-to-component link is declared in two places (ADR front matter and component decision_refs) and has drifted: 5 of 13 links are one-directional and no check catches disagreement, only unresolved references. Making front matter the single declaration and deriving decision_refs at sync removes the second source of truth; moving the ADR files under docs/ puts them where humans and non-Claude agents look for architecture documentation, with the generated index staying in governance/history/.
risks: Three of the four new rules are advisory, so a malformed ADR reports without blocking. Each carries promotion_criteria; decision-refs-are-derived-not-declared is blocking from the start because a hand-declaration is silently overwritten at the next sync.

ADR-001 is added to the skills-check frozen-record set. Its live sections stop being citation-checked as the price of not falsifying an adoption record that deliberately describes the pre-adoption tree.
The related_paths context join is exercised only by tests; no committed ADR declares related_paths yet, so its behaviour on the real tree is unproven until one does.
rollback: git revert restores the ADR files to governance/history/decisions/ and every schema, then make governance-sync regenerates the index, components, effective manifest, catalog, read-surface, and Summary. Kernel files touched: governance/governance.toml and governance/manifests/curated/ownership.json - a revert restores both. Nothing a revert would not restore: the change writes no state outside the repository.
security_impact: None. No runtime, auth, secret, or network surface is touched. The ADR prose moves from the corpus-gated governance/history/ tree into docs/, which governance.toml already lists as always_allow; five files become readable without a governance query, and their content was never sensitive.
summary: Make ADR front matter the authoritative decision-to-component link and move ADRs under docs/architecture/decisions

validators_run.evidence_ref: ruff check and format clean across 75 files
pre-commit all-files; ty and governance-fast-check skipped by the target itself
